reason: Elements cleanup, cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration 027-catalog-required-props (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). (1) ki-indicator holds the bound its contract already declared. The catalog rejects more than 20 positions (the @maximum of count and current), but markup and scripts reach the element without the catalog and one dot renders per position: count="20000" built 20,001 nodes. The component now renders at most 20 positions, reading a single constant that a browser test pins to the maximum the generated manifest declares. A count above 20 renders 20 and exposes "<label>, <current> / 20"; a count from 0 to 20 is untouched. The only surface delta is the description of count on @kimen/elements, which now states that at most 20 positions render; type, default, minimum and maximum are unchanged. (2) Dead code. The declared class of ki-option loses two getters, optionValue and optionDisabled: nothing in the library read them (the owning ki-select derives both from the option's attributes), they were never documented, and they reached the declaration surface only because the class did not mark them private. The gate classifies the changed class signature as MAJOR, as the cumulative delta already was. ki-option.value is no longer declared mutable, which only described writes from inside the component and there are none; the property is assigned from outside exactly as before. Zero removals of exported symbols, no root growth, no CSS or token change. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
